purpose: Correct the real CCMM implementation contract to match Park-2025 Algorithm 3. This explicitly rejects the previous right-CMT/pairwise-position skeleton.

W3c_result.value: component-formula skeleton decrypted but all one-hot/identity tests failed with dense outputs
W3c_result.zh: W3c 证明 C0/C1/C2 公式可运行，但 pairwise skeleton 仍不是论文 PP-MM

main_correction.value: Algorithm 3 transposes U first, not V
main_correction.zh: 论文 Algorithm 3 第一步是 C-MT(U)，不是 C-MT(V)

line1.zh: 对左矩阵 U 的 row-wise ciphertext bundle 做 C-MT，得到 column-wise/transformed U components

line2.zh: 做一次大的 modular PP-MM，产生四个 component matrix

line2_expanded.zh: 这里 @ 是 coefficient/RNS matrix multiplication，不是 DCRTPoly polynomial multiplication，也不是 EvalMult

line3.zh: 对临时 component pair (M01, 0) 做 C-MT

line4.zh: 对临时 component pair (M00, 0) 做 C-MT

line5.zh: 把 sk^2 项 key-switch/relinearize 回 sk 项

line6.zh: 合并三部分并 rescale，得到 row-wise output encryption

raw_component_export.value: export selected c0/c1 DCRTPoly components as coefficient/RNS matrices
raw_component_export.zh: 需要把 ciphertext component 导出成真正可做矩阵乘的 coefficient/RNS matrix

raw_component_ppmm.value: Mij = modular matrix multiplication over raw RNS coefficient matrices
raw_component_ppmm.zh: 需要对每个 RNS tower 做模 q 的矩阵乘法；这才是论文 PP-MM

raw_component_import.value: import PP-MM result matrices back into coefficient ciphertext-like component bundles
raw_component_import.zh: 需要把 PP-MM 结果重新封装为 (M01,0)、(M00,0)、(M10,M11) 这类临时 bundle

temporary_pair_cmt.value: run C-MT on temporary component pair bundles (M01,0) and (M00,0)
temporary_pair_cmt.zh: 不能只对普通 encrypted matrix bundle 做 C-MT，还要能对临时 component pair 做 C-MT
